rules: one canonical application/research source tree: FaceRecognition/
one writer for shared RUN_STATE, claim ledger and contracts
parallel workers use owned paths or staging plus patch and hashes
exclusive board, serial and meter leases
training and device acquisition code holds resource_lease(study_root, resource, owner=...) for the full action; resume reconciles stale rows only after the OS lock is free
J1 controller and capture extensions preserve F/A source ownership and must be requalified against their exact recorded source hashes before physical results qualify

source_paths.FaceRecognition/firmware/: job_F source owner plus J1 adaptive-controller extension under Mac preparation receipt
source_paths.FaceRecognition/nicla_study/instruments/: job_A_instrument_adapter plus J1 Nicla raw capture and synchronized stimulus extension; source receipt required

version_receipts.J1_physical_requalification: required; previous F/H receipts are tied to earlier firmware/config hashes
